name: Gwoza

queries.query: Gwoza Borno Nigeria official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party Borno Geographic Information Service (BOGIS) was found. Its official site says it maps and secures land/property titles, administers land matters, conducts searches, and maintains a land database. The BOGIS public site did not expose an anonymous parcel feature endpoint or downloadable parcel geometry.

queries.query: Gwoza Borno Najeriya taswirar kadastro filaye rajistar ƙasa BOGIS
queries.result: The search did not surface a Hausa-language first-party cadastral viewer or parcel API. English-language official BOGIS pages were the relevant first-party results; the Borno State Internal Revenue Service page exposed land-related fee labels but no safe parcel geometry service.

discoveryMethod: First-party English and Hausa discovery plus bounded anonymous HTTPS/HTML route inspection of the BOGIS public service.
sourceReview: BOGIS is a local/state land administration and cadastral custodian for Borno State, not merely general national agency prose. Official BOGIS material describes title, registration, searches, a state land database/digital repository, and a Cadastral Administration System (CAS). The regulations identify UTM Zone 32N on Minna Datum as the official coordinate system. Gwoza-specific parcel coverage and public anonymous feature access were not evidenced.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official BOGIS homepage loaded over TLS. It identifies BOGIS as the Borno State Geographic Information Service and says it maps/secures land and property titles. The page contained no parcel layer, map viewer, schema, or geometry response.

Official help page states BOGIS is the digital repository of registered properties and transactions and can provide maps/surveys/geospatial data on request. It provides no anonymous parcel feature response.
Official BOGIS page loaded and corroborated the state land-administration role and digital certificate/land-regulation context; no public parcel schema or geometry was exposed.

Official Borno State regulations state that BOGIS LAS is the land-administration platform, BOGIS CAS is the cadastral mapping platform, the digital repository includes land-use cadastre, and the official coordinate system is UTM Zone 32N/Minna Datum. This is custodianship/schema context, not a parcel feature response.

Current HTML and linked JavaScript/configuration were inspected. The public shell is informational, contains application/registration navigation, and exposes no map tile, WFS, WMS, REST feature, or parcel-search endpoint. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA, or token bypass was attempted.
Bounded anonymous probes of likely public route names returned the site's 404 response. This is an unavailable-route observation only and was not treated as citywide cadastral absence.
A public HTML page loaded, but bounded inspection found no safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response or map/API configuration. It was not used as a parcel source.

Official Borno State Internal Revenue Service page lists land and survey-related fees, including map/survey/title transactions. It is a general fee/payment page, not a cadastral map or parcel feature service.
